cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_GPU_PROJECTS
cmakeSwitch.comment: Generate the GPU projects, if possible.

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_GPU_PROJECTS_ONLY
cmakeSwitch.comment: Generate ONLY the GPU projects, if possible.

cmakeSwitch.name: NV_USE_STATIC_WINCRT
cmakeSwitch.comment: False=/MD (dynamic CRT, when building into own application), True=/MT (static CRT, when creating binary packages for redistribution)

cmakeSwitch.name: NV_USE_DEBUG_WINCRT
cmakeSwitch.comment: True=/MDd or /MTd (debug runtime in debug builds), False=/MD or /MT (release runtime in debug builds)

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_GPU_REDUCED_ARCHITECTURES
cmakeSwitch.comment: Generate only a reduced number of GPU architectures for faster compilation

cmakeParam.name: CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX
cmakeParam.comment: Install path relative to PhysX SDK root
